title_en: RiDEx: Reward-Informed Directional Exploration for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: RiDEx：奖励引导的方向性探索用于扩散强化学习
summary_en: RiDEx introduces reward-informed directional exploration for diffusion reinforcement learning, concentrating local exploration in reward-relevant subspaces of the denoising velocity field. It uses conditional residuals or differentiable reward gradients to propose the subspace, and measures terminal reward response via equal-and-opposite perturbations at the same generation state. The reward difference provides signed local supervision in explored coordinates, while all generated images contribute to global DiffusionNFT learning. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, RiDEx achieves the highest peak rewards on four alignment and preference tasks, with its gradient-direction instantiation achieving 15x and 29x target-attainment speedups over DiffusionNFT on HPSv2 and PickScore, measured in H200 GPU hours.
summary_zh: RiDEx 为扩散强化学习引入了奖励引导的方向性探索，将局部探索集中在去噪速度场中与奖励相关的子空间。它通过条件残差或可微奖励梯度提出子空间，并在同一生成状态下使用等大反向扰动来测量终端奖励响应。奖励差异在探索坐标中提供带符号的局部监督，同时所有生成的图像都贡献于全局 DiffusionNFT 学习。在 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 上，RiDEx 在四个对齐和偏好任务中取得了最高的峰值奖励，其梯度方向实例在 HPSv2 和 PickScore 上相比 DiffusionNFT 分别实现了 15 倍和 29 倍的目标达成加速（以 H200 GPU 小时计）。
content_en: Reward-based diffusion post-training updates model parameters from task rewards. While existing approaches improve sampling and policy optimization, they still rely largely on isotropic random perturbations in a high-dimensional latent space for exploration. Such variation often spends the perturbation budget on changes with little influence on the target reward, making exploration inefficient. We study where diffusion models should explore and how to learn from that exploration. We introduce Reward-Informed Directional Exploration (RiDEx), which concentrates local exploration in reward-relevant subspaces of the denoising velocity field. Conditional residuals or differentiable reward gradients propose the subspace, and equal-and-opposite perturbations at the same generation state measure its terminal reward response. The reward difference supplies signed local supervision in the explored coordinates, while all generated images contribute to global DiffusionNFT learning. RiDEx thereby couples exploration-space selection with feedback about the changes it produces. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, RiDEx attains the highest peak rewards among the evaluated methods on four alignment and preference tasks. Its gradient-direction instantiation achieves 15x and 29x target-attainment speedups over DiffusionNFT on HPSv2 and PickScore, measured in H200 GPU hours.
